author: @superm1

evidence.api_compatibility: No API impact. The change does not touch any API surface — no exported functions, no config options, no CLI contracts, no persistence formats, no protocol changes. The only file modified is the CMake build script.
evidence.documentation: No documentation changes needed. This is an internal build-system fix for a Debian FTBFS. The committed tsconfig files (the source of truth for editor/typecheck) remain on moduleResolution: bundler. The node16 rewrite only affects staged copies used by system-package builds.
evidence.manual_release_testing: N/A. This is a pure build-system change to src/web-app/BuildWebApp.cmake — a CMake function that rewrites tsconfig files during staging. There is no user-visible surface: no CLI flags, no API changes, no GUI changes, no new behavior a user can directly exercise. CI and distro builds provide the necessary verification.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. The two PR commits (9487bf6 and 7d29cf4) were authored on 2026-08-27. The first approval was submitted on 2026-08-31T16:27:01Z. The commit is identical to the last PR commit — no post-approval churn.
evidence.review: PR #3186 received three substantive review comments from @fl0rianr before final approval at 2026-08-31T16:27:01Z. Reviewer 1 flagged removing outDir and the module/moduleResolution combination potentially emitting CommonJS (first review). Reviewer 2 identified the TS5110 blocker — transpileOnly does not skip validation of module/moduleResolution consistency — and suggested rewriting moduleResolution to node16 only for TypeScript < 5.0. Reviewer 3 approved after the author pivoted to the final cmake-only approach with outDir restored, noting comfort because the node16 rewrite is isolated to staged system-package builds and the distro matrix was green. The reviewer has subject-area expertise: per docs/dev/contribute.md, @fl0rianr covers 'ci' among other areas. No commits were added after the first and only approval.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change reads and rewrites tsconfig.json files in a staging directory using CMake file(WRITE) with regex substitution. No network calls, credential handling, code execution, or supply-chain changes are introduced.
evidence.tests: No standalone tests were added for the CMake function, which is appropriate given the change is build-system logic that gets exercised through the distro build matrix. CI coverage is extensive: all Linux distro builds pass (Arch, openSUSE), all Launchpad PPA builds pass (Ubuntu 24.04/25.10/26.04 on x86_64 and ARM64), Debian 13 packaging builds pass, and smoke tests on Debian 13 pass. The author also verified the fix in Debian via salsa (https://salsa.debian.org/debian/lemonade/-/pipelines/1152495) and linked the passing job.

subject: Switch to bundler module resolution for tsconfig (#3186)
summary: Adds a CMake function that rewrites tsconfig moduleResolution to node16 when system nodejs modules are used, fixing a TypeScript 7.0 FTBFS in Debian.
verdict_reason: This is a focused 19-line build-system change with thorough iterative review, comprehensive distro CI coverage, and verified Debian build success.
